name: multi-length
description: Mixed short and long requests to demonstrate the benefit of continuous batching (vLLM) over serialized serving (baseline FastAPI). Swap datasets by adding a new JSON here and passing --dataset <name>.

requests.label: medium
requests.prompt: Explain in one sentence what an LLM serving engine does.

requests.label: medium
requests.prompt: List three benefits of using an OpenAI-compatible API for LLM serving.

requests.label: long
requests.prompt: Write a detailed essay explaining how continuous batching in an LLM serving engine such as vLLM improves GPU utilization compared with serialized serving. Cover token-level scheduling, how short and long requests share a batch, tail latency for short requests under load, and the practical difference you would observe when benchmarking the two approaches.
